Score = E + D + P* + (4 − R). Tier A needs ≥11, E = 3, a fact dated on/after 2025-04-09 (macro facts only for FIN) and RA ≥10; A+ needs RA ≥11; robust = 12. RA = score − ceil(shock/3). Downturn: diamond shock weight doubled.
Ranked lead = RA + M + H + F − G; ties by fit then Census 2022 population (no rotation); ≤2 places per unit in each top-10. Envelope = band midpoint × (lead score × population) share.
Rates: P13.84/US$ (9 Oct 2026), R1.207/P (7 Oct 2026). Data: countries-states-cities-database (ODbL 1.0); Census 2022. Sheets prefixed I2_ are carried over unchanged.
